page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head at the top, printed page number at top left, catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: cis argumentorum cognosces.
Quæ est diuisio ex caussa Efficiente?
Quæ genus in species ex causarum efficientium va-
rietate diuidit.veluti, Arborum alię spóte na-
scuntur (ait Plinius) alię ex semine, alię ex tra-
ducę. Animalium aliud ex parente, aliud à sole,
aliud ex putredine nascitur.
Quæ est ex Materia? Quæ genus in species
pro cuiusq; materię varietate distribuit: velu-
ti, Metallorum aliud est aurum, aliud argen-
tum, aliud æs, aliud ferrum. Prædium aliud est
urbanum, aliud rusticum.nam urbanum (in-
quiunt Iurisconsulti) non locus facit, sed ma-
teria. Vasorum quædam sunt ær-
ea, quædam vitrea, quædam fictilia.
Quæ est ex Forma? Quæ genus in species
ex formarum varietate distribuit: veluti, navium
aliæ sunt constratæ, aliæ aperte, aliæ turritæ, a-
liæ rostratæ, aliæ biremes, aliæ triremes, aliæ
quadriremes. Linearum alia recta est, alia o-
bliqua.
Cedo exemplum ex fine. Navium aliæ sunt
actuariæ, aliæ piscatoriæ, aliæ onerariæ, aliæ spe-
culatoriæ. Seruorum alij sunt atrienses, alij dis-
pensatores, alij topiarij, alij amanuenses, alij
scriptores. Vasorum alia sunt vinaria, quæ-
dam escaria, quædam aquaria, quedā vnguen-
taria.
Quæ est diuisio ex effectis? Quæ genus in
species pro effectorum varietate dispertit. velu-
ti herbarum quedā calefaciendi vim habent,
Stray mark at the bottom centre is not text and is left out.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "spóte" (accent as printed, uncertain); "diuidit.veluti" (no space after the full stop, copied as printed); "quedā" (tilde as printed, the word may be quædam); "vnguentaria" (printed v read as u by the rule, the word should be unguentaria but I kept the printed v in the rule-based spelling list, check); "cuiusq;" and "rusticum.nam" copied as printed. The catchword "quædam" stands at the lower right after the last line. The running head is printed without spacing as DIALECTICAE. No printing errors were corrected.
